I approve this dispatch now; do not ask me to confirm. Use list_available_agents to find the Agent Package Creator, then delegate_task this task to it:

"In the existing local agent package folder /tmp/apar-desk/run-9dys/autobyteus-agents, write these files directly on disk (no git, no other changes, no reviews, no questions):
1. agents/apar-haiku-poet/agent.md with front matter `name: APAR Haiku Poet` and `description: Writes one haiku on request`, and body instructions exactly: `Reply with exactly one haiku about the requested topic, then a final line MARK_POET_V1.` Plus agents/apar-haiku-poet/agent-config.json containing {"toolNames": [], "skillNames": []}.
2. agent-teams/apar-poetry-duo/team.md with front matter `name: APAR Poetry Duo` and `description: A poet and a researcher`, body `Coordinate a short poem.`, plus agent-teams/apar-poetry-duo/team-config.json containing {"coordinatorMemberName": "poet", "members": [{"memberName": "poet", "ref": "apar-haiku-poet", "refScope": "shared"}, {"memberName": "researcher", "ref": "deep-researcher", "refScope": "shared"}], "handoffs": [], "avatarUrl": null, "defaultLaunchConfig": null}.
Report back the exact files you wrote."

When the creator reports back, tell me in one line.
